metadata.description: Friendly name shown in the Workbooks saved list or gallery.
Resource/source the workbook is associated with. For Defender for Cloud workbooks, Azure Security Center is commonly used.
Unique GUID for this workbook instance. Use a fixed GUID if you want repeat deployments to update the same workbook.
Azure region for the workbook resource.
JSON array string containing one or more Log Analytics workspace resource IDs used by each workbook query crossComponentResources property.
